name: com.csht.localinit.usb.boardcast.UsbReceiver
description: The CSHT (中软高科) ID-card reader SDK uses this receiver to notice when its compatible USB reader is attached, detached, or granted access, then open the reader and update its connection state.
disableEffect: The app will lose automatic detection and reconnection for this USB ID-card reader, so card reading through it will not work.
